text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list: Good work. That was an indisputably great run!
Good work. That was an indisputably great run!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thank you very much.
Hearing those words really puts my mind at ease.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Body and mind, everything fell into place perfectly.
All that conditioning was well worth it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you look so happy, Trainer,
makes today a perfect score.
choice_data_list: For a student with a perfect score... we've gotta celebrate!
For a student with a perfect score... we have to celebrate!
You'll be matched with even stronger opponents from now on!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:

makes today a perfect score.
choice_data_list: For a student with a perfect score... we've gotta celebrate!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Is that...
a box from the pastry shop in front of the station...?
choice_data_list: I knew you'd come back with a win!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I see. Perhaps that, too, is what it means to be a good mentor...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I'm learning a lot, in all sorts of ways.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall gladly accept your kindness.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And to make up for it,
I'll be sure to live up to your expectations in the next race.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Now that body and mind are fully conditioned,
our training efficiency will increase as well.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We must level up even more before the next race.
Let us build a rock-solid foundation.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Results follow only through untiring dedication and study, after all.
